NXLog | Agent Lead (C/Rust/AI), Senior Rust, Senior Test Automation Devs | REMOTE (European time zones preferred) | Full-time B2B Contract

NXLog (https://nxlog.org) is an engineering-led company building high-performance, multi-platform log collection and telemetry solutions. We specialize in low-level systems programming (C/Rust) for enterprise security.

We are currently hiring for three critical roles on a full-time B2B contract basis:

A. Agent Lead Developer (Rust/C/AI): Architect the evolution of our core agent. Lead the C-to-Rust transition and AI orchestration. Link: https://application.nxlog.org/jobs/detail/agent-lead-develop...

B. Senior Rust Developer: High-concurrency, high-throughput systems. Memory safety and performance optimization. Link: https://application.nxlog.org/jobs/detail/senior-rust-develo...

C. Senior Test Automation Engineer: Build automated frameworks for complex C/Python systems. Performance and CI/CD focus. Link: https://application.nxlog.org/jobs/detail/senior-test-automa...

The Details:

Rates:

A. Agent Lead Dev: USD 45–55/hr B. Sr Rust Dev: USD 40-50/hr C. Sr Test Automation Eng: USD 33-43/hr

Type: Full-time availability required.

Location: Remote (European time zones preferred).

Tech Stack: Rust, C, Python, Linux/Windows Internals.

We value technical autonomy and deep expertise. If you enjoy solving hard systems problems, apply via the links or email sarika.sinha@nxlog.org.
